title: From subsystem to AI full-stack product
subtitle: Build the application around the evidence contract and demonstrate engineering judgment.
goal: Connect the layers into one defensible product
intro: A portfolio becomes convincing when you can follow one task from user intent to verified result and recovery.
terms: A small feature through every layer
case: Deliver one narrow assistant that answers knowledge questions and prepares an approved request.
Every feature has a traceable contract and an observed result.
A broad chat demo may hide missing authorization or durability.
